summary: Focana 2.4.6 is a small hotfix that keeps focus sessions running through missed check-ins and tightens compact mode's Tasks preview.
improvements: Missed check-ins now record the miss and clear the prompt without pausing the active timer.
Compact mode's Tasks preview now sizes the temporary expanded window to the visible panel instead of leaving hidden space below it.
fixes: Missing a check-in no longer drops users into a generic Ready to resume loop while they are still trying to stay with the current task.
The compact Tasks preview now aligns closer to the bottom work-area edge when expanded from the floating pill.
